description: Text a client an invite to their BAMF space from the BAMF line (+1 213-853-2189). Agency staff keys only. Finds the client's mobile from their Notion space, then GoHighLevel; asks when neither has it (pass phone). The invite is client role with client view locked (only the agency owner can change it). TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only (number source, masked number, SMS draft with {invite_link}); call again with confirm=true only after the user approves that exact text. Never treat an earlier approval as standing permission.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name (must be a client of an agency you own, admin, or manage).

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true creates the invite and texts it.

phone.description: Client mobile, only when the plan says needs_phone.

text.description: The approved SMS text; keep {invite_link} where the link goes.

name: bamf.invite_client_to_space
